subject.title: marketplace-crons: eBay falla al publicar ofertas en bulkPublishOffer y el cron lo absorbe

question: For eBay create/publish, should a bulkPublishOffer batch with zero successful publications fail or escalate the /api/ebay cron response, or should it remain HTTP 200 with stronger internal alerting?
rationale: The code can add detail mechanically, but changing the cron-level success signal affects monitoring and multi-phase cron semantics that need maintainer/operator intent.

options.title: Escalate zero-success publish batches
options.body: Treat a publish batch with no successful offers as a phase failure or equivalent alert before re-enabling eBay create.

options.title: Keep HTTP 200 with stronger alerting
options.body: Continue allowing other phases to finish but add explicit per-offer logs and priority notification for zero-success publish batches.

options.title: Keep create disabled
options.body: Leave eBay create off until the account/policy rejection family is handled operationally outside this code path.

recommendation.title: Escalate zero-success publish batches
recommendation.body: Treat a publish batch with no successful offers as a phase failure or equivalent alert before re-enabling eBay create.

likelyOwner.reason: JavierHamelyn owns the most recent eBay cron mitigation in current history and is closest to the cron-level operational decision.
